summary: Phase 2 FortexaRH TSS/IR Export Testing Complete. All 12 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified - Reportes tab shows 3 sections: Exportar Nóminas, Archivos TSS, Reportes DGII. Download buttons work correctly, generating valid XLS files.
critical_code_review_comments: tss_generator.py correctly implements xlwt for Excel generation with proper TSS v5.3 and v5.1 formats
Export endpoints properly validate period status (only paid periods can be exported)
Excel files have correct XLS magic bytes (D0 CF 11 E0) confirming valid format
UI correctly shows TSS and DGII sections only for paid periods
seed_data_creation: Used existing paid periods for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 TSS/IR export features fully tested. Key endpoints verified: 1) GET /api/payroll-v2/periods/{id}/export/tss-autodeterminacion - Returns XLS file with TSS v5.3 format, 2) GET /api/payroll-v2/periods/{id}/export/tss-novedades - Returns XLS file with TSS v5.1 format, 3) GET /api/payroll-v2/periods/{id}/export/ir3 - Returns IR-3 Retenciones Excel, 4) GET /api/payroll-v2/periods/{id}/export/ir17 - Returns IR-17 Declaración Excel. All endpoints require paid period status. UI Reportes tab shows 3 sections correctly.

ui_download_buttons.details: Autodeterminación, Novedades, IR-3, IR-17 buttons visible and functional
